name: Risaralda (Caldas, Colombia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, yellow at the hoist and green at the fly, charged at the centre with a red disc bearing two clasped hands in white.
history: Municipal flag of Risaralda, a municipality in the department of Caldas, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: two clasped hands on the disc
